notes.paths: every file is relative to this manifest's directory
notes.atlas_uv: cell i -> col = i % cols, row = floor(i / cols) counted from the TOP of the image; with three.js flipY=true use v0 = 1 - (row+1)/rows. Inset UVs by pad/cell on each side if you scale sprites past the drawn body; the pad is fully transparent.
notes.atlas_colour: cells are pre-coloured; multiply by white (optionally a +-8% per-seed jitter). tint is the class accent for halos, labels, links, flow particles and the anim overlays; multiplying a cell by its own tint will over-saturate it.
notes.alpha: straight alpha; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0. Normal blending (SrcAlpha, OneMinusSrcAlpha) draws the body solid; AdditiveBlending draws it as light (fine on the black sky).
notes.size: relative radius; pve_host = 1.0 reference. Scale by your shell spacing.
notes.emissive: 0..1 share of the body that should feed bloom; multiply colour by (1 + emissive*k) with k tuned so only cores cross the bloom threshold.
notes.spin: sprite rotation in rad/s; 0 for bodies with a baked light direction (rotating them would swing the sun). Add seed-derived phase. Down bodies: spin 0.
notes.util_cells: halo/ring/spark/disc are white utility cells in the same atlas: halo under a busy body, ring for selection/new, spark for flow heads, disc = tintable generic moon.
notes.anims: flipbook frame f (0-based) -> col = f % cols, row = floor(f / cols) from the TOP; loop:true sheets are seamless (last->first step measured <= a normal step); loop:false sheets start and end near empty, play once. tint:true sheets are white: multiply by the class tint. 'scale' is the overlay size relative to the body.
notes.render: cells 0,2,3,11,12,13,16,18,19 and every turntable are Cycles path-traced from universe_cycles.py; the rest of the atlas is the NumPy bake (kept where it read better).
notes.trimmed: The public build ships the assets both screens load by default: the celestial look (static/assets/celestial) replaced the per-class 3D models, matcaps, turntables and cloud layers, so those are not included; every consumer falls back to its procedural placeholder when a manifest key is absent.

pulse.use: emissive core breath + one ripple per cycle; drive fps from latency (pulse period)

birth.use: nova for a body with new=true; play once, frames 0 and 31 are ~empty

death.use: collapse when a body goes down; last frame is exactly empty

exhaust.use: rocket/comet plume, nozzle at the TOP edge of each cell, flows down (-v)

flow.use: link particle stream: map u along the link, set RepeatWrapping, offset.x -= speed*dt; heads point +u
